title: Revit Working Library - Annotation

entries.name: Text - General Notes
entries.line_spacing_guidance: about 1.15-1.2 times font size for paragraphs; single spacing for short notes
working_guidance: use bullets or numbering for multi-line notes
avoid manual indentation and manual blank-line spacing

entries.name: Text - Dimensions and Leaders
entries.line_spacing_guidance: single for dimension strings; about 1.0-1.1 for leaders
working_guidance: avoid overlap with tags and symbols

entries.name: Text - Titles and Subtitles
entries.case_guidance: UPPER for titles; Sentence for subtitles
working_guidance: use a larger paper size than general notes

entries.name: Dimension Style - Plan Overall
entries.tolerance_guidance: nominal only unless a contract or project requirement governs tolerances
working_guidance: prefer baseline strings for repeated features

entries.name: Dimension Style - Detail Tight
entries.intended_use: detail callouts and sections where higher precision may be required
entries.rounding_guidance: round to the governed precision without biasing fit
entries.tolerance_guidance: show only where contractually or technically required

entries.name: Door Tag
entries.appearance_guidance: fixed paper-size text with frame; optional leader

entries.name: Equipment Tag
entries.appearance_guidance: multi-line text; optional frame; leader allowed; fixed paper size

entries.name: Grid Head
entries.appearance_guidance: circular fixed-size bubble with grid identity

entries.name: Level Head
working_guidance: coordinate displayed elevation basis with the governed project datum

entries.name: Spec-linked Keynote Pattern
working_guidance: prefer associative element or material keynoting over independent text

entries.name: Controlled Internal Annotation Code Pattern
entries.pattern: compact controlled codes for repetitive notes or project-defined callouts

working_rules: Use controlled text, dimension, tag, and symbol types rather than ad-hoc local variants.
Tolerance values remain project/BEP/contract dependent unless separately governed.
Tags should align with governed parameter identities and schedules.
New tag or annotation families remain candidates until their identity, parameter set, appearance, and approval path are established.

provenance.migration_note: Useful annotation examples retained as non-authoritative working data. Organization/client/project identifiers removed.
